description: orient2d (raw robust-predicates package call, argument order ax,ay,bx,by,cx,cy) and GeometryPredicates.orientation (the real production wrapper) evaluated over a broad input matrix. f64 inputs are recorded as big-endian IEEE-754 bit-pattern hex strings; only the SIGN of orient2d and the exact -1/0/1 orientation result are asserted, per ruling R9 (only predicate signs are consumed in production).
